chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from Abu 'Ali al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn 'Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar, who said:

I said to Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام: For the one performing ifrad hajj, when he has performed tawaf of the House and the safa and the marwah, should he bring forward Tawaf al-Nisa'? He said: No. Tawaf al-Nisa' is only after he comes to Mina.

key_terms.الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ: the two sacred points between which sa'y is performed
key_terms.بِالْحَجِّ: in the state of performing hajj
key_terms.طَوَافَ النِّسَاءِ: the tawaf required in hajj after which marital relations become permissible
key_terms.مِنًى: the sacred site of Mina, where hajj rites are completed in sequence

ai.seo_question: When should Tawaf al-Nisa' be performed in ifrad hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the order of rites for one performing ifrad hajj. It states that Tawaf al-Nisa' should not be done immediately after tawaf of the House and sa'y between al-Safa and al-Marwah, but rather after coming to Mina.
